picks.editorial_note: An $874M federal commitment under the CHIPS and Science Act to accelerate domestic semiconductor R&D is one of the largest funding actions of the week and directly targets the compute supply chain that AI research depends on.
picks.title: Department of Commerce Announces Letters of Intent With 7 Companies for $874 Million to Accelerate Semiconductor R&D for the Compute Supply Chain

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $100M State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs program broadens compute access nationally and builds workforce pipelines, a structural investment that will shape AI research capacity for years.
picks.title: New NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs will power AI-enabled scientific research across the country

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's brain-computer interface let an ALS patient speak again in his own voice — a landmark demonstration of AI-driven neuroprosthetics with immediate, life-changing real-world impact.
picks.title: Giving People Their Voice

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope marks a genuine technical first, showing how autonomous AI systems can directly operate scientific instruments to accelerate discovery.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: NIST's MOU with the DOE Office of Science formalizes federal coordination under the White House-led Genesis Mission, signaling a significant policy-level push to align national AI R&D priorities.
picks.title: NIST Joins National Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI Innovation

picks.editorial_note: A new $21.5M NSF AI Institute for Human-AI Cooperation, spanning Delaware, Princeton, Penn, and UF, represents a substantial multi-institution investment in AI for rehabilitation and health care.
picks.title: UF researchers join new NSF-funded AI institute to transform rehabilitation and health care

picks.editorial_note: RPI's selection for two DOE Genesis Mission projects, including a national-lab partnership on rare-earth materials discovery, exemplifies deepening academic-government collaboration on AI-accelerated science.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: HKU engineers' atomically thin in-memory search chip pushes AI hardware toward fundamentally new, more efficient computing architectures — a notable materials-science and chip-design advance.
picks.title: HKU Engineering develops atomically thin “analogue in-memory search” chip to redefine AI computing limits with minimalist architecture - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's AI framework for predicting solid-state reaction pathways could meaningfully speed up materials discovery, a concrete example of AI accelerating fundamental science.
picks.title: New AI Modeling Approach Accelerates the Development of Advanced Materials

picks.editorial_note: USC's large-scale AI model mapping regional brain aging, trained on nearly 15,000 MRI scans, offers a powerful new tool for understanding and eventually addressing dementia risk.
picks.title: AI-aided measures of brain age offer insights on dementia, more
